reviews.text: I’ve been taking my French Bulldogs, Chihuahuas, and cats to Squaw Peak for five years, and I have always trusted the staff to care for my animals as deeply as I do. Over the past two years, I’ve had to say goodbye to three beloved pets, and I cannot fully express my gratitude for the kindness and compassion everyone showed during those difficult times. The team has truly been a group of angels for my whole herd of pets and an especially wonderful resource for my French Bulldogs. Frenchies can have a long list of health issues, and I know I can depend on the experts at Squaw Peak to understand the breed. If you have a flat-faced dog, I highly recommend taking them to Squaw Peak. They are also amazing with Chihuahuas and cats, but they are hands down the experts when it comes to bulldogs.

Extremely rude unhelpful staff. The Vet spent 5 min with us, didn’t even look at us while talking about cancer, diabetes or liver disease without even looking or examining my cat and then wanted to prescribe meds without a diagnosis. Terrible manners, no empathy whatsoever!!! When I said I did not feel comfortable medicating my pet without knowing why, they charged me $95 for a 5 min rushed “consultation”. Do yourself and your pet a favor, read the reviews and take them elsewhere.
Very good service and excellent attention.

There are no words to express how grateful we are to Dr. Mike Ferrera. He truly saved our sweet Lulu’s life.

Yesterday, when we rushed her in, she had a life-threatening airway emergency that required immediate surgery. Dr. Ferrera happened to be the veterinarian on duty that day, and because he is the surgeon at the practice, Lulu was able to get the emergency care she desperately needed without delay. We were later told that if she hadn’t received surgery as quickly as she did, she likely would not have survived. After she was stable, he and his staff referred us to a higher level of care so she could be safely monitored and she was able to come home with us later last night.

Not only is Dr. Ferrera an incredibly skilled surgeon, he is also compassionate, calm, and took the time to keep us informed during one of the scariest days of our lives. You can tell he genuinely cares about his patients and the families who love them.

Today, Lulu is home recovering because of Dr. Ferrera’s expertise and quick action. We will never forget what he did for our family. Thank you, Dr. Ferrera, for giving us more time with our little girl. You will always have our deepest gratitude. And our dogs will never go to any other vet clinic.
I would highly recommend Squaw Peak Animal Hospital. They have been my vet of choice since 1993
